description:
Canada is a popular destination for international students seeking quality education and diverse opportunities. If you are considering studying in Canada and plan to take the Pearson Test of English (PTE) for language proficiency assessment, you may be wondering which colleges and universities in Canada accept PTE scores. In this article, we will explore the PTE accepted schools in Canada, the required PTE scores, and other relevant information.

To help you make an informed decision, we have compiled a table below that showcases some of the universities in Canada that accept PTE scores. The table also includes the required PTE score and any additional requirements for each institution:

Minimum PTE score: 65, with no section below 60. Some programs may have higher requirements.

Minimum PTE score: 60, with no section below 60. Certain programs may have higher requirements.

Minimum PTE score: 59, with no section below 56. Please note that some programs may require higher scores.
